headline: The 6 races that could decide Senate control
author: Julia Mueller

paragraphs.text: All six seats rated as “toss-ups” by DDHQ — Texas, Maine, Alaska, Ohio, Iowa and Kansas — are currently held by Republicans.   Here’s what to know about the races that will decide Senate control:  The Senate race in Texas has been one of this cycle’s most closely watched, from Democrat James Talarico’s rising-star bid amid GOP-friendly redistricting to incumbent Sen. A recent Emerson College Poll found the race in a dead heat and noted that Libertarian candidate Ted Brown could pull some support on Election Day, potentially tipping the race in Talarico’s favor. Hispanic and Latino voters could also be a game-changer.
